opening.argument: The video examines OneCoin as an alleged fraud rather than inviting viewers to participate in it: the narration reports that Ruja Ignatova was accused of defrauding victims of more than $4 billion, describes the payout structure as “a classic Ponzi scheme,” and presents her whereabouts and the money as subjects of investigation. It also challenges the purported token value, explaining that the exchange rate was “completely made up” and that investors could exchange only small amounts. The separate commercial segment is expressly identified as Surfshark sponsorship and directs viewers to a named site and checkout code for extra VPN subscription time, an ordinary product offer rather than an investment solicitation.

citations.quote: Ruja Ignatova, who became known as the missing crypto queen, has been accused of defrauding victims out of more than $4 billion.
A lucrative business for a tiny number of people at the top of the pyramid everyone else earns very little or nothing at all, a classic Ponzi scheme.
But this exchange rate was completely made up. Investors were only able to exchange small amounts as appetisers to keep them happy.
